decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore, in order to play Primeval Titan and utilize its powerful ability to search for lands like Lotus Field and Gruul Turf. The goal is to cheat out powerful lands and combo pieces, such as Crumbling Vestige and Scapeshift, to quickly overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and game-ending combos. The deck's synergy with Amulet of Vigor allows for explosive plays and ensures that the player can swiftly assemble their win condition.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Faithless Looting and Thought Scour. By utilizing reanimation spells like Persist and Unearth, the deck aims to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce help disrupt the opponent's plans, while Fatal Push provides removal for threats. The deck also includes cards like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus for additional graveyard synergy and control options.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly flood the board with artifact creatures and utilize cards like Cranial Plating and Paradise Mantle to boost their power and toughness. The deck aims to play aggressively and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures, while also generating card advantage through cards like Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor. The inclusion of Urza's Saga allows for powerful artifact tutoring, further enhancing the deck's consistency and explosiveness. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and efficient, aiming to win through relentless aggression and synergy between its artifact-based cards.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber to generate additional mana and play Primeval Titan as quickly as possible. The deck aims to ramp into powerful threats such as Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes lands like Urza's Saga and Vesuva to search for powerful utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Lotus Field. The deck uses cards like Spelunking and Explore to dig for combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore, while using Primeval Titan to tutor for lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field. The key strategy is to generate a large amount of mana to combo off with cards like Scapeshift and The Mycosynth Gardens to create a lethal board state. Cards like Urza's Saga and Amulet of Vigor help accelerate the combo even further, allowing the deck to quickly overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggression and speed, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to establish early board presence. The deck also incorporates direct damage spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to push through opponent's defenses. The inclusion of cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional threats and finishers to close out games quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless onslaught of creatures and burn spells, while also providing some flexibility with cards like Static Prison and Elegant Parlor for control elements.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It utilizes artifacts to generate mana and deal additional damage, as well as to sacrifice for additional effects. The key strategy is to constantly apply pressure on the opponent, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt to take control of the game. The deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize and mount a defense.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to ramp up to powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provide versatile removal and control options to disrupt the opponent. The deck also includes ramp spells like Sylvan Scrying and Expedition Map to help find the necessary lands quickly. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through powerful threats and disruption while ramping up its own resources.

This deck focuses on utilizing Broodscale Bloodchief's ability to sacrifice Eldrazi creatures to gain control of opponents' creatures. The deck includes various cards to ramp up mana quickly, along with removal spells and creatures to disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces needed to take over the board and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck aims to control the game until it can execute its game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Emperor of Bones. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga to generate card advantage and provide additional threats. It utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Kozilek's Command to control the board. The deck aims to quickly close out the game by overwhelming the opponent with a combination of disruption and aggressive threats.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, while providing support with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. It also includes cards like Arena of Glory and Ocelot Pride to boost the creatures' effectiveness. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and relentless attacking strategy, utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to provide additional threats and control options. The goal is to finish the game swiftly before the opponent can establish a strong defense.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays while also utilizing blink effects to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy. By combining creatures with powerful abilities like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp with aggressive threats like Overlord of the Balemurk and Fatal Push, the deck can apply pressure while also keeping the opponent off balance. The inclusion of Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to effectively respond to the aggressive threats presented by the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by using aggressive creatures like Solitude, Emperor of Bones, and Overlord of the Balemurk. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can also disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain tempo advantage. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. The key strategy is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with control elements.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief and various supporting cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Blade of the Bloodchief. The goal is to ramp up with Eldrazi Temple and other lands, while using cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board. The deck also includes tools for searching for key pieces like Ancient Stirrings and Traverse the Ulvenwald. Overall, the strategy revolves around building up your board presence and overwhelming your opponent with a deadly combination of creatures and abilities.

This deck is focused on aggressive gameplay, with a mix of red, green, white, and blue cards to provide a variety of threats and removal options. The key strategy is to quickly play efficient creatures like Territorial Kavu, Wild Nacatl, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and utilize powerful combat tricks and burn spells to quickly finish off the opponent. The deck aims to maintain a steady stream of pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds additional threats and synergies to the deck, creating a fast-paced and explosive gameplay experience.
